title: Hybrid Identity Implementation
scenario: A healthcare organization is moving from a fully on-premises Active Directory environment to a hybrid identity model integrated with Microsoft Entra ID. Before the organization can rely on synchronized sign-in for Microsoft 365 and later device management, the directory must be prepared, the cloud domain must be verified, user principal names must be aligned to the cloud namespace, Microsoft Entra Connect must be configured with Password Hash Synchronization, and the resulting synchronization must be validated.

activities.title: Task 1 - Verify the Custom Domain
activities.prompt: You want to prove ownership of the custom cloud domain before it can be used for hybrid identity. To answer, move the appropriate actions from the list of actions to the answer area and arrange them in the correct order.
steps: Open Microsoft 365 Admin Center and start the Add domain workflow
Open the domain DNS management console
Create the TXT record using the values provided by Microsoft
Return to Microsoft 365 Admin Center and select Verify
answer: Open Microsoft 365 Admin Center and start the Add domain workflow
Open the domain DNS management console
Create the TXT record using the values provided by Microsoft
Return to Microsoft 365 Admin Center and select Verify
activities.explanation: The domain must be added in Microsoft 365 first, verified by TXT record, and then confirmed back in the admin center.

activities.title: Task 2 - Interpret the IdFix Workflow
activities.prompt: You want to prepare the on-premises directory for synchronization by using IdFix. To answer, match each IdFix action on the left with the outcome or purpose on the right.
right: Scans Active Directory for synchronization issues
Commits approved changes to Active Directory

answer.Query: Scans Active Directory for synchronization issues
answer.Apply: Commits approved changes to Active Directory

activities.explanation: The lab uses IdFix to detect, approve, and commit attribute corrections before synchronization begins.

activities.title: Task 3 - Add the Correct UPN Suffix
activities.prompt: You want all synchronized users to sign in with a UPN that matches the verified cloud domain. To answer, select the UPN suffix that should be added in Active Directory Domains and Trusts.
activities.explanation: The custom cloud namespace must be added as an alternative UPN suffix before user UPNs are updated.

activities.title: Task 4 - Build the Bulk UPN Update Script
activities.prompt: You want to bulk-update user UPNs in several departmental OUs so they match the verified cloud domain. To answer, move the PowerShell blocks from the list of actions to the answer area and arrange them in the correct order.
activities.explanation: The script imports the module, defines the target suffix, defines the OU list, loops through each OU, and updates the UserPrincipalName value for each user.

activities.title: Task 5 - Verify UPN Changes
activities.prompt: You want to verify that users in the Human_Resources OU now have updated UPN values. To answer, select the appropriate value for each blank in the script.
activities.explanation: The lab validates the Human_Resources OU specifically and displays SamAccountName together with UserPrincipalName.

activities.title: Task 6 - Configure Microsoft Entra Connect
activities.prompt: You want to complete the Microsoft Entra Connect deployment with Password Hash Synchronization and selected OU filtering. To answer, move the appropriate actions from the list of actions to the answer area and arrange them in the correct order.
steps: Open Entra Connect and then open Connect Sync
Download the latest Entra Connect Sync version
Select Password Hash Synchronization and do not enable Single Sign-On
Connect to the Microsoft Entra tenant with Global Administrator credentials
Add the on-premises directory using administrator@newvue.local
Choose Sync selected domains and OUs and select only Administration, Clinical_Services, Human_Resources, IT_Operations, and Finance
Enable Start the synchronization process when configuration completes and then select Install
answer: Open Entra Connect and then open Connect Sync
Download the latest Entra Connect Sync version
Select Password Hash Synchronization and do not enable Single Sign-On
Connect to the Microsoft Entra tenant with Global Administrator credentials
Add the on-premises directory using administrator@newvue.local
Choose Sync selected domains and OUs and select only Administration, Clinical_Services, Human_Resources, IT_Operations, and Finance
Enable Start the synchronization process when configuration completes and then select Install
activities.explanation: The lab explicitly requires PHS, no SSO, tenant authentication, on-premises directory connection, selected OU filtering, and immediate synchronization.

activities.title: Task 7 - Map the Synchronization Stages
activities.prompt: You want to confirm that directory synchronization completed successfully by reviewing Synchronization Service Manager. To answer, match each synchronization stage on the left with the correct description on the right.
right: Imports changes from Active Directory into the synchronization engine
Processes imported data and determines what changes should be applied
Writes processed changes to Microsoft Entra ID

answer.Delta Import: Imports changes from Active Directory into the synchronization engine
answer.Delta Synchronization: Processes imported data and determines what changes should be applied
answer.Export: Writes processed changes to Microsoft Entra ID

activities.explanation: The Operations tab is validated by confirming the presence and success of Delta Import, Delta Synchronization, and Export.

activities.title: Task 8 - Validate a Synchronized User
activities.prompt: You want to confirm that a user object was synchronized correctly and is ready for Microsoft 365 sign-in. To answer, select the result that best proves successful synchronization in Microsoft Entra ID before license assignment.
options: The On-premises sync column shows Yes and the UPN uses the custom domain
The user appears only in Active Directory Users and Computers
The tenant Overview page displays the default onmicrosoft.com domain
The user signs in with a local Administrator account on NV-DC1
activities.answer: The On-premises sync column shows Yes and the UPN uses the custom domain
activities.explanation: The lab verifies both synchronization origin and the updated cloud-facing UPN before proceeding to licensing and cloud sign-in.

activities.title: Task 9 - Complete Final Access Validation
activities.prompt: You want to confirm that a synchronized on-premises user can actually consume Microsoft 365 services after directory synchronization. To answer, select the action that must occur immediately before the user signs in to portal.office.com.
options: Assign an available Microsoft 365 license to the synchronized user
Run IdFix Query again on NV-DC1
Change the on-premises domain from newvue.local to yourname.2bd.net
Reinstall PowerShell 7 on the domain controller
activities.answer: Assign an available Microsoft 365 license to the synchronized user
activities.explanation: The final validation sequence in the lab is to assign a Microsoft 365 license and then test sign-in in a private browser window.
